description: This file is a header file for the DM_AmxUpDownload module. It declares functions related to device download and upload operations, including initialization and retrieval of queued transfers. It also includes licensing information and include guards.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_DoDownload
methods.description: Initiates a device download operation with parameters like command key, file type, URL, credentials, file size, target filename, delays, and callback URLs.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_DoUpload
methods.description: Starts a device upload operation with parameters like command key, file type, URL, credentials, and delay seconds.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_GetQueuedTransfers
methods.description: Retrieves the list of queued transfer operations for the device.
